narrative:
## Handover Summary — BU Revenue Targets

FY2027 revenue targets are locked at GBP 3.80B and cascaded to 37 service-line and region cells.

## Key Decisions
- UK Insurance GBP 2.01B, Dental GBP 540M, Care Services GBP 420M, Clinics & Hospitals GBP 350M, Bupa Global GBP 480M
- Clinics & Hospitals and Dental uplifts accepted on demand evidence
- Group ambition gap held at -1.3%, inside the 2% tolerance

## Recommendations for Claims & Cost of Care
- Price claims inflation by service line, not as a single group assumption
- Link Corporate PMI cost of care to the renewal pricing in this phase

## Risk Factors
- Corporate renewal retention below 92% in Midlands & East
- FX exposure on Bupa Global premiums

signals.title: Oracle EPM BU Planning Paused
signals.excerpt: Business-unit planning on Oracle EPM has been paused. Group planning already runs on Snowflake after the TM1 to Anaplan to Snowflake migration delivered with EY.

signals.title: NHS Elective Waiting List Above 7 Million
signals.excerpt: Referral-to-treatment waiting times continue to drive self-pay and PMI demand for diagnostics, orthopaedics and cataract procedures.
